title: Evaluation compatibility of native open tensor representatives
statement:
theorem nativeOpenTensorGammaEvaluation {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (SZ : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E Z)
    (O : SystemOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
      SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
    (On : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
      SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n) :
    GammaEvaluation l E j SX SZ O On

proof.text: On homogeneous tensor generators, exact finite evaluation preserves the open unit, restriction comparison, and signed total summands; vertical pullback preserves K-flat representatives.
Bilinearity, sheafification, and tensor descent extend the generator equality to all derived pairs, yielding GammaEvaluation.

mathlib_searches.query: Extension by zero of sheaves commutes with derived tensor product and finite coefficient evaluation
mathlib_searches.results: Eight generic sheaf-cohomology and zero tensor facts; no native open tensor model existence theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No direct match; use the existing project interfaces.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived compact support reduction tower transitions and normalized open tensor finite evaluation
mathlib_searches.results: Eight unrelated condensed module and test-function facts. Loogle NatTrans.naturality found the generic naturality square used in assembly, not a model construction.

Project search found only data definitions and model consumers; Mathlib search found no such construction. Blueprint search point sections found det-pbc-torsion-stalk-proetale-point, which concerns a geometric point, not R-linear sequence sections. Existing open normalization uses independently chosen localized-site tensors and is insufficient by direct application.
mathlib_searches.verdict: New interface specialization, retaining the stated construction dependencies.
